hook:
Two natures.

AMG added rear-axle steering and two rear seats, then made the tourer harder-edged rather than softer.
body:
Hand-assembled 4.0-litre biturbo V8, rear-axle steering, active roll stabilisation — and, now, two seats in the back that nobody expected.

2025 Mercedes-Benz AMG GT 63 4MATIC+ — 577 hp · 590 lb-ft · 0–60 mph in 3.1 sec.

· 577 hp and 590 lb-ft from a hand-assembled 4.0-litre biturbo V8.
· 3.1 seconds to 60 mph and 196 mph, through 4MATIC+ all-wheel drive.
· Rear-axle steering and active roll stabilisation, on a car sold as a tourer.
· Two seats in the back this time, which nobody expected and everybody uses.

It is positioned between grand tourer and sports car, and specified for both.
cta: Grand tourer or sports car — which one did they actually build?
